definition: rest-pose readings (degrees): neck flexion and side bend of neck-to-head against pelvis-to-neck; shoulder elevation [left, right] of clavicle-to-glenohumeral above the plane normal to pelvis-to-neck
assumption: the rest pose head is neutral (rendered: SMPL, SMPL-X, cskel27 and SOMA77 rest poses are upright and face forward)

excluded.motionlcm: joint positions are predicted directly (HumanML3D representation): no rigid skeleton, so no verifiable zero; 18.5% of E4 frames put the head point less than 3 cm above the neck point
excluded.omnicontrol: joint positions are predicted directly (HumanML3D representation): neck-to-head length 0.12-0.14 m against 0.083 m of SMPL, so the SMPL zero does not apply; with it nearly every frame reads 14-18 deg extension

notes.dart: zero of SMPL-X male, betas 0 (dart_feedback FK); the E4 path exports DART environment joints with a 2.4% within-clip neck-to-head length variation and a constant 22 deg side-bend median: E4 DART neck readings are flagged
notes.chois: per run: rest pose rebuilt from raw/native_prediction.npz (bone offsets in the parent frame are constant to 3e-7 m), fallback SMPL-X neutral
notes.kimodo: skeleton joints.p; the skin bind pose reads 20.5 deg (1.6 deg higher)

shoulder_check: clavicle-to-glenohumeral length matches the zero skeleton: CLoSD 0.102 / SMPL 0.102, PRIMAL 0.116 / SMPL-X neutral 0.116, DART 0.143 / SMPL-X male 0.144, ARDY 0.159 / cskel27 0.159, Kimodo 0.160 / SOMA77 0.160 m; MotionLCM and OmniControl 0.12 m (+20% against SMPL) with within-clip variation up to 5.4%. The rest pose has arms out, so arms-down frames read below zero (SMPL family 11-24 deg, ARDY 3 deg, Kimodo 8.5 deg): the zero and the 10 deg threshold are conventions
